ds:39bda6c1dfa4be56.source: YOU'LL NEED A KEY TO GET THIS CELL OPEN!
ds:39bda6c1dfa4be56.translation: 得有钥匙才能打开这间牢房！

ds:608a9de78b1a5d05.source: DON'T TRY AND HIT THE DOOR, IT WON'T WORK.

ds:15167377d57ccfd7.source: YOU'LL NEED TO FIND A KEY TO OPEN IT.
ds:15167377d57ccfd7.translation: 你得找到钥匙才能打开。

ds:66ea9325a4b4beb6.source: THE DOOR'S ALREADY OPEN, YIFFANY! BUT THANK YOU!
ds:66ea9325a4b4beb6.translation: 门已经开了，伊法妮！不过还是谢谢你！

ds:1aa038c2ea72395b.source: SOME CREEPY ROBED GUY LOCKED ME UP IN HERE!
ds:1aa038c2ea72395b.translation: 有个穿长袍的怪家伙把我关在这里了！

ds:ff70a709bb16d324.source: YOU COULD LET ME OUT, IF YOU HAVE A KEY...
ds:ff70a709bb16d324.translation: 要是你有钥匙，就能放我出去……

ds:30a11d540d5fa991.source: W-we could open this cell if you had a k-k-key! You've got one, right?
ds:30a11d540d5fa991.translation: 你、你要是有钥、钥匙，就能打开这间牢房！你有的，对吧？

ds:c78b7a37dc13a676.source: There's no way to open this cell w-without a key! Hurry up and get one p-please!
ds:c78b7a37dc13a676.translation: 没钥匙就打、打不开牢房！拜、拜托你快去找一把！

ds:665e6578955c413b.source: W-why did they lock me up? I'm just a scout!
ds:665e6578955c413b.translation: 他、他们为什么把我关起来？我只是个侦察兵啊！

ds:3ba68fd76401d6a4.source: Thanks a bunch! I never thought I'd end up in alien jail.
ds:3ba68fd76401d6a4.translation: 太感谢了！没想到我竟会被关进外星监狱。

ds:73d0591c54cf9a40.source: Do you really think you're strong enough to break this barrier?
ds:73d0591c54cf9a40.translation: 你真觉得自己有那么大力气，能打破这道屏障？

ds:6a9a090690ed9783.source: If you spot any of those strong dwarves, send 'em my way!
ds:6a9a090690ed9783.translation: 要是见到那种力气大的矮人，叫他们来找我！

ds:fefd3ef3bd14c79c.source: I bet one of them could break me out!
ds:fefd3ef3bd14c79c.translation: 我敢说他们肯定能把我弄出去！

ds:53af4f29fc3e0b64.source: Bye bye. If you wanna help, go find someone strong!
ds:53af4f29fc3e0b64.translation: 再见。想帮忙的话，就去找个力气大的来！

ds:7872fe7d128c5bb0.source: Well do you have a plan, or are you just gonna stand there lookin'?
ds:7872fe7d128c5bb0.translation: 你到底有没有计划，还是就打算站着干看？

ds:81757e8c2574ebea.source: Oh, do you think you can break me out of here?
ds:81757e8c2574ebea.translation: 哦，你觉得自己能把我救出去？

ds:ff14ae4fb6ba1247.source: This outta be fun to see...

ds:0331f6fdd92657a2.source: Well then, I guess you're stronger than I thought!
ds:0331f6fdd92657a2.translation: 好吧，看来你的力气比我想的大！

ds:31073a679025504a.source: I can make my way back to the hangar myself, no need to carry me.
ds:31073a679025504a.translation: 我自己能回机库，不用你背。

ds:2586e86773685f37.source: It's an energy barrier, nothing complicated.
ds:2586e86773685f37.translation: 就是道能量屏障，没什么复杂的。

ds:d7caf436379c7e71.source: No offense, but you look a bit weak to break it yourself.
ds:d7caf436379c7e71.translation: 无意冒犯，不过看你这样子，恐怕没力气自己打破它。

ds:25ca642065dfc9b4.source: Yeah yeah... Don't go around all puffed up over this.
ds:25ca642065dfc9b4.translation: 好啦好啦……别因为这点事就到处得意。

ds:35b3be15f7cdf50f.source: Seeya girl! Be careful out there!
ds:35b3be15f7cdf50f.translation: 再见啦，小姑娘！在外面小心点！

ds:9b5ef2f5f0859bd3.source: ...eh, fiiine. I guess this vacation had to end sooner or later.
ds:9b5ef2f5f0859bd3.translation: ……唉，好——吧。我想这假期迟早也得结束。

ds:9cd1410f32a24bbf.source: The kobolds bring me food and everything.
ds:9cd1410f32a24bbf.translation: 狗头人还给我送吃的，什么都照顾到了。

ds:233ba1023a63ad7f.source: You look like a smart and eager dog!
ds:233ba1023a63ad7f.translation: 你看起来真是只聪明又有干劲的狗！

ds:7f222dee9487bc01.source: Did you know that ferals are able to dig up dirt by pressing DOWN+ATTACK?
ds:7f222dee9487bc01.translation: 你知道野兽形态可以按DOWN+ATTACK挖开泥土吗？

ds:59a8e472fb0d5e24.source: I'll be right along, heheh! My leg kinda fell asleep...
ds:59a8e472fb0d5e24.translation: 我马上跟来，嘿嘿！腿好像有点睡麻了……

ds:b65d541ad0fe301d.source: Huh? Oh. It's just a dog.

ds:3c884d80725fc4dc.source: I guess you can't help me get out of here, huh girl?
ds:3c884d80725fc4dc.translation: 你大概没法帮我出去吧，小姑娘？

ds:fd468957b14b1652.source: Oh, are you going to get help? Yay!
ds:fd468957b14b1652.translation: 哦，你要去找人帮忙吗？太好啦！

ds:48a8aecf1d165eae.source: Oh... I guess you aren't going to let me out...?
ds:48a8aecf1d165eae.translation: 哦……看来你不打算放我出去……？

ds:0ce953fb6f65b4db.source: I've been cooped up in here forever and it's sooo boring!
ds:0ce953fb6f65b4db.translation: 我被关在这里好久了，真是无聊透了！

ds:047d7a2187e72289.source: Will you let me out, pleeease?
ds:047d7a2187e72289.translation: 放我出去好不好，求——你啦？

ds:aaf92c17c63f266d.source: Thanks for double-checking, but I'll be fine!
ds:aaf92c17c63f266d.translation: 谢谢你又来确认，不过我没事啦！

ds:1674b73c26059887.source: Some big kobolds locked me up in here.
ds:1674b73c26059887.translation: 几个大块头狗头人把我关在这里了。

ds:03ba7c5d9b99a5c6.source: And I thought they were my friends...
ds:03ba7c5d9b99a5c6.translation: 我还以为他们是我的朋友呢……

ds:59a4f87361fd7d7b.source: I'll see you back at the hangar!

ds:1e187138dc3ce410.source: Ooohhh! You're a sight for sore eyes!
ds:1e187138dc3ce410.translation: 哦哦哦！见到你可真是太好了！

ds:d10362d30664fc7b.source: C-c'mon, you've *got* to get me out of here! You don't know what it's like!
ds:d10362d30664fc7b.translation: 拜、拜托，你*一定*得把我救出去！你不知道这里有多难熬！

ds:5bfedf803ed147fd.source: I wanna run and jump, but I've been cooped up here for weeks...!
ds:5bfedf803ed147fd.translation: 我想跑跑跳跳，可我已经被关在这里好几个星期了……！

ds:2d1b8a8f14da0fc4.source: Please help me, good girl! You just gotta find someone...
ds:2d1b8a8f14da0fc4.translation: 帮帮我，乖姑娘！你只要去找个人来……

ds:466457f12b5dc38b.source: Come back soon! I can't take much more of this boring room!
ds:466457f12b5dc38b.translation: 快点回来！这无聊的房间我真的快待不下去了！

ds:a911409fce1b0669.source: Don't tease me... please... just lemme out now!
ds:a911409fce1b0669.translation: 别逗我了……求你……现在就放我出去吧！

ds:813862a02d167c68.source: You'll need a key! I've tried... everything...
ds:813862a02d167c68.translation: 你得有钥匙！我已经……什么办法都试过了……

ds:96ca30ef3066bebb.source: Please unlock my cell! Let me go free!
ds:96ca30ef3066bebb.translation: 求你打开牢门！放我自由吧！

ds:108c3e61516df629.source: I'm fine now. Just need a minute to stretch my legs.
ds:108c3e61516df629.translation: 我现在没事了。只需要点时间活动活动腿脚。

ds:f43c341b94ad6189.source: They locked me up in this cell as soon as we landed!
ds:f43c341b94ad6189.translation: 我们刚降落，他们就把我关进了这间牢房！

ds:c12c8df7fb566d30.source: I'm going stir crazy in here! I just wanna ruuun!
ds:c12c8df7fb566d30.translation: 我被关得都快疯了！我只想出去跑——啊！

ds:aa3d1e216a36529a.source: Actually I feel like my legs are kinda cramped now...
ds:aa3d1e216a36529a.translation: 其实现在感觉腿好像有点抽筋了……

ds:6e8c4bd4a159726b.source: So I'll probably just make my way back to the hangar and relax.
ds:6e8c4bd4a159726b.translation: 所以我大概会先慢慢回机库，休息一下。

ds:be25612e453e7926.source: A real primo, high end model too... except it's broken.
ds:be25612e453e7926.translation: 还是顶级的高端型号呢……只可惜坏了。

ds:89b3754f6e0dbaac.source: And here you are, to brighten up my day!
ds:89b3754f6e0dbaac.translation: 你一来，我这一天都亮堂了！

ds:a0bbee210c728000.source: You and that torch are lifesavers.
ds:a0bbee210c728000.translation: 你和那支手电筒真是救星。

ds:4c8dedc91b57f9f6.source: Those space pirates are gonna regret crossing me...
ds:4c8dedc91b57f9f6.translation: 那些太空海盗一定会后悔招惹我……

ds:3c541a06baf7594f.source: Oh hey, what brings you here?

ds:dfbc96da67d5de2d.source: I guess I'll get back to the hangar and start filing my reports...
ds:dfbc96da67d5de2d.translation: 看来我得回机库，开始整理报告了……

ds:062320cceeebd0ce.source: Do you wanna hang out and enjoy the forest with me?
ds:062320cceeebd0ce.translation: 想留下来，和我一起享受森林吗？

ds:316f497747461964.source: Really, no need to bust things up on my account. I'm doing great, eh-heh.
ds:316f497747461964.translation: 真的，没必要为了我砸坏东西。我过得挺好的，诶嘿。

ds:d009b8f43d1e3b64.source: Really? Do you *have* to bust me out of here?
ds:d009b8f43d1e3b64.translation: 真的？你*非得*把我弄出去吗？

ds:8a1aafec94e1a781.source: Meep... guess you're telling me to get back to work...
ds:8a1aafec94e1a781.translation: 呜……看来你是叫我回去工作啊……

ds:f7bc68fc2ec5ba9a.source: Yeah yeah, I'll start working on my paperwork...
ds:f7bc68fc2ec5ba9a.translation: 好啦好啦，我会开始处理文书的……

ds:a5d92d2d410980b9.source: Honestly, all the running around and training fauna was soo tiring.
ds:a5d92d2d410980b9.translation: 说实话，到处跑来跑去、训练动物，真的好累。

ds:6202d2c4d74fb486.source: I don't mind a little vacation, eheheh...
ds:6202d2c4d74fb486.translation: 放个小假我也不介意，诶嘿嘿……

ds:2aa0920032b7ee54.source: Did I really look like I was in trouble or something?
ds:2aa0920032b7ee54.translation: 我看起来真的像遇上麻烦了吗？

ds:0711ecf918e5e367.source: Don't worry about me, I'll be along later.
ds:0711ecf918e5e367.translation: 别担心我，我待会儿就跟上。

ds:651a7a508b594783.source: You know, I'm gonna miss chilling out here in the forest.
ds:651a7a508b594783.translation: 说真的，我会想念在森林里悠闲度日的时光。

ds:82f7c6bc15c01402.source: It's got some totally rad vibes!
ds:82f7c6bc15c01402.translation: 这里的氛围简直棒极了！

ds:4a580a60f16fe027.source: Lot more loot in it than being a cosmo agent, heh-heh...
ds:4a580a60f16fe027.translation: 比当宇宙特工能捞到的好处多多了，嘿嘿……

ds:9fef49321d42b861.source: It gets my fur all mussed up!

ds:bf7603daf5f2d3dc.source: GIVE THEM SOME ATTENTION AND PETS ONE MORE TIME WHILE HOLDING THIS CRYSTAL
ds:bf7603daf5f2d3dc.translation: 拿着这块水晶，再关心它们一次、摸摸它们。

ds:bf68b1f60e37fe32.source: AFTER YOU'VE MAXED A PET'S CONFIDENCE, RETURN HERE FOR A SPECIAL REWARD.
ds:bf68b1f60e37fe32.translation: 把宠物的自信提升到最高后，回来领取特别奖励。

ds:ddf41475f90a3145.source: JUST PET THEM WHILE THEY'RE AT FULL CONFIDENCE TO CHARGE THE CRYSTAL.
ds:ddf41475f90a3145.translation: 在它们自信满满时抚摸它们，就能给水晶充能。

ds:09d847d2963ff620.source: [YEAH, HAVEN'T SEEN ANYTHING DANGEROUS HERE YET]
ds:09d847d2963ff620.translation: [是啊，目前还没见到什么危险的东西。]

ds:792263b7b2a537a2.source: [THAAAT'S RIGHT! OUR SATELLITE HAS A CONSTANT STREAM OF]
ds:792263b7b2a537a2.translation: [没——错！我们的卫星一直在源源不断地传来]

ds:fa53bf20016fd946.source: [SORRY YIFFANY, THE ONLY SATELLITE IN THE AREA]
ds:fa53bf20016fd946.translation: [抱歉，伊法妮，这一带唯一的卫星]

ds:c81dd055ee56f92e.source: [GOOD JOB TAKING CARE OF THAT BRUTE, YIFFANY!]
ds:c81dd055ee56f92e.translation: [干得好，伊法妮，把那个蛮横的大块头收拾了！]

ds:76c98d15257f991d.source: [THANKS BOSSU, I JUST WISH HE DIDN'T RUN AWAY]

ds:f8264d57dce7947d.source: [THAT'S GONNA MAKE IT EXTRA HARD TO CALM HIM DOWN...]
ds:f8264d57dce7947d.translation: [这样一来，要让他冷静下来就更难了……]

ds:0953fbd5282d3fc9.source: [DO YOUR BEST UNTIL YOU MANAGE TO GET PROPER EQUIPMENT]
ds:0953fbd5282d3fc9.translation: [在设法找到合适装备之前，先尽你所能，]

ds:d18e1d4b19dd5d56.source: [SO THAT WE CAN HELP OUT THESE CREATURES ON TUTONE.]
ds:d18e1d4b19dd5d56.translation: [这样我们才能帮助图托恩的这些生物。]

ds:35b59fe307a553fd.source: [OF COURSE, I'LL SEE IF I CAN TRACK HIM DOWN AGAIN.]
ds:35b59fe307a553fd.translation: [当然，我会再试着找到他的下落。]

ds:150f35487b6e7f2c.source: [MANAGED TO HOLD YOUR OWN, EH YIFFANY?]

ds:dad31a5f760da0eb.source: [YEAH, BUT THE BIG FELLA MANAGED TO SLIP AWAY AGAIN.]

ds:1f1c898e4424d0cf.source: [WAS HOPING TO CAPTURE THEM SO WE COULD FIGURE OUT]
ds:1f1c898e4424d0cf.translation: [本来希望把他们抓住，好弄清楚]

ds:3d14e9aed16a2ac9.source: [WHAT EXACTLY IS GOING ON DOWN ON THIS PLANET.]
ds:3d14e9aed16a2ac9.translation: [这颗星球上到底发生了什么。]

ds:ca4c9a23bd25054a.source: [THAT'S RIGHT, THEY WERE A LITTLE ROUGHED UP]

ds:e83af746b1de2354.source: [KEEP AN EYE OUT FOR OTHER AGENTS THAT YOU CAN RESCUE!]

ds:e5a3f760776b7577.source: [WE MANAGED TO SET IT ON FOLLOW MODE]
ds:e5a3f760776b7577.translation: [我们设法把它设成了跟随模式。]

ds:bc033831e0f49179.source: [GREAT, THEN I CAN GO AND BLAST THOSE DARN SHIPS THA-]
ds:bc033831e0f49179.translation: [太好了，那我就能去轰掉那些该死的飞船——]

ds:bab7413034d33f98.source: [AND YOU CAN TAKE A LOOK AT THEM.]

ds:17e2714ad4daf541.source: [NOW NOW, YOU MAY BE ONE OF OUR TOP AGENTS]
ds:17e2714ad4daf541.translation: [好啦好啦，你或许是我们的顶尖特工之一，]

notes: intentional-corruption/source-preserved；原JAR前后演出与独立复核确认刻意广播干扰，保留Latin碎段，不猜补DEF...ING，不计完整中文。
intentional-corruption/source-preserved；独立复核确认广播刻意失真，保留Latin碎段，不把TEN或END猜补成触或尽头，不计完整中文。

ds:d5293c99d48d2a54.source: [YOU'RE BREAKING UP WAY TOO MUCH, LET ME GET OUT OF HERE]
ds:d5293c99d48d2a54.translation: [你那边断断续续的太严重了，等我先出去，]

ds:ebf9c11b55c0a36a.source: [AND THEN YOU CAN TELL ME ABOUT THE BIG TEN...]
ds:ebf9c11b55c0a36a.translation: [然后你再跟我说说那个BIG TEN...]
notes: 源BIG TEN...故意停在碎片处，保留原Latin碎段，不猜补为大触手等词。

ds:922afe30f652ba03.source: [THE KIND THAT DOESN'T COLLECT SHOES, I GUESS?]

ds:ca22b1a60637053c.source: [OH COME ON, IT WAS JUST A BIT OF ROUGHHOUSING!]
ds:ca22b1a60637053c.translation: [拜托，只是稍微打闹了一下嘛！]

ds:582713a8912059ef.source: [HE EVEN GAVE ME A GIFT FOR GOING EASY ON HIM!]
ds:582713a8912059ef.translation: [他还送了我礼物，感谢我手下留情！]

ds:ffb299d5453c8dfb.source: [THE SATELLITE  STOPPED TRANSMITTING DATA UNTIL JUST NOW]
ds:ffb299d5453c8dfb.translation: [那颗卫星直到刚才才恢复数据传输。]

ds:d87e67044bf8be1e.source: [LISTEN BUSTER, I'M GETTING REAL TIRED OF YOUR CRA-]
ds:d87e67044bf8be1e.translation: [听着，混蛋，我受够了你这堆破——]

ds:db0b745920bb1a47.source: [TO A LOW ORBITING MOON THAT SEEMS TO HAVE BEEN A PRISON?]
ds:db0b745920bb1a47.translation: [到了那颗低轨道卫星，看起来那里以前是监狱？]

ds:a15bde291d1240da.source: [OH HEY! FINALLY FOUND A PROPER TRAINER TAZER, HUH?]
ds:a15bde291d1240da.translation: [哦，嘿！终于找到一把像样的训练电击器了？]

ds:4b6ce5b7d9afcd30.source: [YUP, NOW I CAN CAPTURE A FEW OF THE CREATURES DOWN HERE]
ds:4b6ce5b7d9afcd30.translation: [对，现在能抓几只这里的生物了，]

ds:7207e32cfa139482.source: [AND WE CAN SORT WHAT'S HAPPENING ON THIS PLANET.]
ds:7207e32cfa139482.translation: [我们也就能弄清这颗星球发生了什么。]

ds:4ae7061bd966dc27.source: [YOU CAN CALL ME "THE0"! THOUGHT I'D HELP YOU OUT BY]

ds:282dd8778fb1d28b.source: [JUST GIVE ME A CALL AT 28.250 AND I'LL FILL YOU IN!]

ds:073717f001ed0a7a.source: [...LET ME KNOW WHEN YOU'RE OUT OF THAT SUIT...]
ds:073717f001ed0a7a.translation: [……等你脱了那身装束再告诉我……]

ds:cdb9477ca7de2a59.source: [THE MORE THEIR CONFIDENCE WILL BE BOOSTED!]
ds:cdb9477ca7de2a59.translation: [它们的自信就会提升得越多！]

ds:1030f086a377ab68.source: [MAYBE YOU'LL EVEN GET A REWARD AS THANKS...]
ds:1030f086a377ab68.translation: [说不定还会送你礼物表示感谢……]

ds:a745f0ccd5a60235.source: [TRY NOT TO ATTACK THEM HEAD ON]

ds:3ceb2bdf753448d9.source: [OR YOU MAY BE ON THE RECEIVING END OF THEIR SWIPES!]
ds:3ceb2bdf753448d9.translation: [不然你可就要挨它们的爪子了！]

ds:c7841451a54737df.source: [IF I DIDN'T KNOW BETTER, I'D THINK YOU WERE AN ESPER]
ds:c7841451a54737df.translation: [要不是心里有数，我会以为你是个超能力者，]

ds:7edcc72d597423a8.source: [ISN'T THERE SOME WAY TO DEACTIVATE THEM AGAIN?]

ds:667c72bbf83e5570.source: [ALWAYS GOING ON ABOUT DIGGING DEEPER AND GREEDIER]
ds:667c72bbf83e5570.translation: [总是在念叨着挖得更深、更贪婪，]

ds:8ac3f7a58209cc62.source: [AND NEVER SHUTTING UP ABOUT THE DRUMS! EVER LOUDER!]
ds:8ac3f7a58209cc62.translation: [还没完没了地说着鼓声！越来越响！]

ds:3b4cf17a41346f5e.translation: [它们自己发动攻击的那一刻。]

ds:b8ba9d80f0a62d15.source: [SO TRY TO CATCH THEM IN THE MIDDLE OF A DIVE.]
ds:b8ba9d80f0a62d15.translation: [所以尽量趁它们俯冲时出手。]

ds:3e945dc15b0fb65a.source: [EEP! YOU'D THINK THEY MISTOOK ME FOR ONE OF THEIR OWN]
ds:3e945dc15b0fb65a.translation: [咿！它们简直把我当成了同类，]

ds:d9dee512c21bb672.source: [WITH THE WAY THEY WERE NIPPING AT ME...]

ds:1ed5867168c43d7f.source: [COME ON, I'M A PRO! I WON'T GET DISTRACTED!]
ds:1ed5867168c43d7f.translation: [拜托，我可是专业的！才不会分心！]

ds:e0727314415d1a96.source: [FOR THE SAKE OF YOUR VIT BAR, I HOPE NOT, AGENT.]
ds:e0727314415d1a96.translation: [为了你的体力条着想，我也希望如此，特工。]

ds:6801406af2382531.translation: [在那颗卫星的东北部，伊法妮。]

ds:690925c2b9f82614.source: [UH, YIFFANY? ARE YOU IN A KOBOLD SUIT?]

ds:b61745aee6e8d54a.source: [YEAAAH THIS JUST MAKES IT KINDA AWKWARD.]

ds:a6f0bc381174830d.source: [MAYBE CALL ME BACK WHEN YOU'RE OUT OF THAT THING?]
ds:a6f0bc381174830d.translation: [不如等你脱掉那东西再打给我？]

ds:2976303340a509f1.source: [HEY COME ON, IT'S NOT THAT WEI-]

ds:55a912ef1c5ae218.source: [DID THAT GRRRL REALLY GET BEATEN UP BY SOME KOBOS]
ds:55a912ef1c5ae218.translation: [那姑娘真被几只狗头人打败了，]

ds:cc7a50b02801a5f2.source: [HOPE SHE FINDS IT AGAIN ONCE SHE COMES AROUND, SERIOUSLY]
ds:cc7a50b02801a5f2.translation: [说真的，希望她醒过来之后能再找到它。]

ds:62a0cdd663368c5e.source: [YOU KNOW WHAT THEY SAY! EVERY DOG NEEDS A BONE TO CHEW]
ds:62a0cdd663368c5e.translation: [俗话说得好！每只狗都得有根骨头啃，]

ds:66ca7dcad1c5161e.source: [AND THESE ONES WILL FILL YOUR VIT UP JUUUST A LIL BIT!]
ds:66ca7dcad1c5161e.translation: [而这些能给你恢复那——么一点体力！]

ds:55658826a5c39550.source: [YEAH, BUT I PREFER THE KIND THAT CLEAN YOUR TEETH TOO]
ds:55658826a5c39550.translation: [嗯，不过我更喜欢还能洁牙的那种。]

ds:7a1881aac6259a6b.source: [HEY, TAKE YOUR SNACKS WHERE YOU CAN GET 'EM!]

ds:a229cbf37e8e297c.source: [THE DNA DOESN'T MATCH ANYTHING IN OUR DATABANKS]
ds:a229cbf37e8e297c.translation: [它的DNA和我们数据库里任何东西都对不上，]

ds:6cea22c8a9c37f81.source: [IT SHOULD RECOVER A DECENT CHUNK OF YOUR VIT, TOO!]
ds:6cea22c8a9c37f81.translation: [它应该还能给你恢复不少体力！]

ds:56c39dd192986cae.source: [REMEMBER, YOU USED TO ALWAYS TRADE THEM OFF FOR SNACKS.]
ds:56c39dd192986cae.translation: [记得吗，你以前总拿它们去换零食。]

ds:8c582d5164fac9cb.source: [OF COURSE! I DRANK THE FIRST ONE I EVER GOT!]
ds:8c582d5164fac9cb.translation: [当然！我第一次拿到手就喝掉了！]

ds:846019798750f25b.source: [THAT'S HOW I LEARNED THAT IT WAS BETTER TO TRADE EM]
ds:846019798750f25b.translation: [就是那次让我明白，还是拿去换东西比较好。]
